const patch = "*** Begin Patch

+"""RoboPaint episode controller for the limited-mode lettering task."""
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+import sys
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+R = Robot()
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])
+
+
+def pose_xyz(x, y, z, q=Q_DOWN):
+    return np.array([x, y, z, *q], dtype=float)
+
+
+def submit_path(points, note="", camera=None):
+    """Send Cartesian waypoints at <= 5 mm per 20 Hz control step."""
+    points = np.asarray(points, dtype=float)
+    now = np.asarray(R.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=float)
+    seq = [now]
+    for target in points:
+        dist = np.linalg.norm(target[:3] - seq[-1][:3])
+        # Keep small spatial steps for the pen and let the server slerp rotation.
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(dist / 0.005)))
+        for f in np.linspace(0., 1., n + 1)[1:]:
+            seq.append(seq[-1] + f * (target - seq[-1]))
+    actions = np.asarray(seq[1:], dtype=np.float32)
+    res = R.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=0.05, video="none", note=note)
+    fails = sum(x.get("ik_failures", 0) for x in res.meta.get("plan", []))
+    if fails:
+        print("IK failures", fails, "in", note)
+    if camera:
+        res.save(str(OUT / camera))
+    print(note, "rows", len(actions), "status", R.status())
+    return res
+
+
+def current_pose():
+    return np.asarray(R.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=float)
+
+
+def lift_to(z=0.07):
+    p = current_pose()
+    q = p[3:]
+    submit_path([pose_xyz(*p[:2], z, q)], "retract pen")
+
+
+def save_obs(cameras, filename):
+    obs = R.get_obs(cameras=cameras)
+    for cam, image in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(image).save(str(OUT / f"{filename}_{cam}.png"))
+    return obs
+
+
+def dip():
+    # The observed center of the ink well; the tip must pass below its surface.
+    x, y = -0.1005, 0.1483
+    q = Q_DOWN
+    submit_path([pose_xyz(x, y, 0.10, q)], "approach ink well")
+    submit_path([pose_xyz(x, y, 0.015, q)], "dip pen into ink")
+    submit_path([pose_xyz(x, y, 0.015, q)] * 8, "hold pen in ink")
+    submit_path([pose_xyz(x, y, 0.10, q)], "lift inked pen")
+
+
+def practice_calibration():
+    dip()
+    # Parallel strokes across the nib, at 1.2, 3.2, and 5.2 mm of press.
+    # A camera check after leaving the practice sheet is saved for calibration.
+    specs = [(-0.220, 0.0195), (-0.1856, 0.0175), (-0.151, 0.0155)]
+    for i, (y, z) in enumerate(specs):
+        x0, x1 = -0.14, -0.08
+        submit_path([pose_xyz(x0, y, 0.05), pose_xyz(x0, y, z)], f"practice pressure {i+1} start")
+        n = 20
+        line = [pose_xyz(x0 + (x1-x0)*t/n, y, z) for t in range(1, n+1)]
+        submit_path(line, f"practice pressure {i+1} line")
+        submit_path([pose_xyz(x1, y, 0.05)], f"practice pressure {i+1} retract")
+    # Park over the gap between the sheets so the practice camera can see the marks.
+    submit_path([pose_xyz(-0.10, 0.0, 0.30)], "park for practice inspection")
+    save_obs(["practice_cam", "canvas_cam", "scene_cam"], "calibration")
+    print("current", current_pose())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    practice_calibration()
*** End Patch";

+def extract_target_centerline():
+    """Thin the ink mask and follow its single continuous cursive centerline."""
+    gray = np.asarray(Image.open("/app/target.png").convert("L"))
+    ink = gray < 130
+    # Restrict thinning to the lettering to avoid noise from the paper texture.
+    top, bottom, left, right = 490, 570, 340, 680
+    skeleton = ink[top:bottom, left:right].copy()
+    changed = True
+    while changed:
+        changed = False
+        for phase in (0, 1):
+            p = np.pad(skeleton, 1)
+            nb = [p[:-2, 1:-1], p[:-2, 2:], p[1:-1, 2:], p[2:, 2:],
+                  p[2:, 1:-1], p[2:, :-2], p[1:-1, :-2], p[:-2, :-2]]

+            else:

+                             (~nb[0] | ~nb[4] | ~nb[6]))

+            if np.any(remove):

+    gray = np.asarray(Image.open("/app/target.png").convert("L"))
+    ink = gray < 130
+    distance = distance_transform_edt(ink)
+    anchors = [(399, 508, 364, 553), (499, 508, 472, 553),
+               (532, 508, 505, 553), (595, 508, 560, 553)]
+    q = nib_orientation(math.radians(-35.))
+    strokes = []
+    for ut, vt, ub, vb in anchors:
+        rows = np.arange(vt, vb + 1, dtype=float)
+        expected = ut + (ub - ut) * (rows - vt) / (vb - vt)
+        centers, radii = [], []
+        for v, pred in zip(rows.astype(int), expected):
+            lo = max(0, int(math.floor(pred - 7)))
+            hi = min(1024, int(math.ceil(pred + 7)) + 1)
+            local = distance[v, lo:hi]
+            center = lo + int(np.argmax(local))
+            centers.append(float(center))
+            radii.append(float(distance[v, center]))
+        centers = gaussian_filter1d(np.asarray(centers), sigma=1., mode="nearest")
+        radii = gaussian_filter1d(np.asarray(radii), sigma=1.5, mode="nearest")
